summary: Run fi-20261028-empty-report-md fully delivered the requested order/refund net-income analysis. Correct verified results: order_count=5, paid_fen=113000, refund_fen=42000, net_fen=71000, 华西=47000, 华东=24000, top2 orders O04=40000 and O02=15000.
